text:
Marta P: Quick sync — Azure marketplace listing: I pushed the draft offer to the staging publisher portal. Need a quick verification pass on three things before we request final validation: roles/permissions for the publisher account, billing SKU mapping (monthly vs commit), and the test tenant to run the end-to-end install. @Devon (Product) can you confirm SKU names and plan IDs? @Simon L (Legal) please confirm the EULA snippet we plan to surface.

Devon (Product): Reviewing now. SKU names should be: Redwood-Inference-Std, Redwood-Inference-Pro, Redwood-Inference-Enterprise. Will confirm plan IDs in 10m. Also check we expose trial flag in the metering plan. :+1:

Simon L (Legal): EULA language looks fine but we need one change — replace "data retention" clause to reference customer's storage policy rather than ours. I'll paste the suggested one-liner below.

Simon L (Legal): "Customer data processed by the offering will be retained only as necessary to deliver the service and in accordance with the customer's configured retention settings; Redwood Inference does not persist customer input for training without explicit consent."

Alexa Ops: For the test tenant, Marcus and I can spin up a sandbox subscription with MSFT partner trial credentials. Marcus, can you confirm the subscription ID and RBAC roles we should grant to the publisher account?

Marcus (Cloud Ops): I'll create a subscription and share credentials in the secure channel. Publisher account needs: Owner on the offer resource group + "Marketplace Publisher" role on the provider registration. Also need Contributor on the resource group used for onboarding scripts.

Marta P: Thanks — two quick practical items: 1) packaging: the artifact manifest should include both container image and VM offer metadata. 2) billing: we need mapping table between our internal plan keys and Azure planId for billing reconciliation. I'll paste minimal manifest example we used for GCP so we have a template.

Marta P: ```json
{
  "offerId": "redwood-inference-standard",
  "displayName": "Redwood Inference - Standard",
  "plans": [
    {"id": "standard", "name": "Standard Monthly", "metering": "monthly"},
    {"id": "pro", "name": "Pro Commit", "metering": "commit"}
  ],
  "artifacts": ["container:ghcr.io/redwood/inference:stable", "vmImage:azure:urn:..."],
  "legal": {"eulaRef": "https://redwood.ai/eula/marketplace"}
}
```

Devon (Product): Plan IDs confirmed: standard -> plan_ri_std, pro -> plan_ri_pro, enterprise -> plan_ri_ent. I'll add a small CSV mapping to the drive.

Simon L (Legal): Confirmed on the EULA edit. Also flagging the need to include export control language for encryption and model weights transfer — small paragraph to append.

Marta P: Good catch. I'll add that.

marketplace-bot: Submission to Azure staging portal accepted (offerId: redwood-inference-standard, submissionId: subm-20260321-88). Status: awaiting publisher verification.

Alexa Ops: Once Marcus shares the sandbox creds I'll run the onboarding script and post the `az marketplace` commands we used. Quick note: for automated validation we need the offer to include at least one sample deployment template.

Marcus (Cloud Ops): Sandbox subscription ID: 9a7f-xxxx-xxxx-1234 (shared privately). I've granted roles per above.

Devon (Product): Uploaded SKU mapping CSV to Drive: /partnerships/marketplace/azure/sku-mapping-176777.csv. Contains internal_key, azure_plan_id, price_tiers.

Marta P: Action items: - Simon to finalize EULA and export-control paragraph (done by EOD) - Devon to attach SKU mapping and packaging manifest (done by EOD) - Marcus + Alexa to validate sandbox deploy and post `az` steps (tomorrow morning PT) - I'll request final validation after checks complete.

Marta P: I'll book a 20-min sync tomorrow 10:00am PT to triage any final blockers. If you can't make it, drop notes in this thread. :calendar:
